20261121-physics-m3-1.title: na rail so ayeke na frottement pëpe
20261121-physics-m3-1.topic: na rail so ayeke na frottement pëpe
20261121-physics-m3-1.goal: Sara kusala na a-ndia ti na rail so ayeke na frottement pëpe ti leke kpale ni.
20261121-physics-m3-1.material: Mbeni montagne russe so masse ti ni ayeke 2 kg, a bâ ni na ndö ti 20 m na ndö ti sese na tî-ngbâ, na rail so ayeke na frottement pëpe. Énergie cinétique ti ni na lâ so a kîri na sese ayeke nyen? (g = 9,8 m/s²)
20261121-physics-m3-1.thinking.0: na rail so ayeke na frottement pëpe
20261121-physics-m3-1.thinking.1: Bibe ti ndara na gingo nda ti ye

20261121-physics-m3-1.s.s1.explain: Na lege ti loi ti conservation ti énergie mécanique, énergie potentielle so a kiri ni kue a changé ni na énergie cinétique. $E_k = mgh = 2\text{ kg} \times 9.8\text{ m/s}^2 \times 20\text{ m} = 392\text{ J}$.

20261121-physics-m3-1.s.s1.hint.1: Sâra calcul ti E_p = m g h = 2 × 9,8 × 20.

20261122-physics-m3-1.goal: Sara kusala na a-ndia ti Dérivation avancée ti leke kpale ni.

20261122-physics-m3-2.title: Ngü ti nzapa so atï na ndö ti nuage so
20261122-physics-m3-2.topic: Ngü ti nzapa so atï na ndö ti nuage so
20261122-physics-m3-2.goal: Sara kusala na a-ndia ti Ngü ti nzapa so atï na ndö ti nuage so ti leke kpale ni.
20261122-physics-m3-2.material: Ngü ti nzapa so atï na ndö ti nuage so ayeke na ndö ti akilomètre mîngi, ti nyen ni la vitesse ti ni akpa kâ pëpe na ayeke ngbâ na mbeni vitesse so ayeke ngbâ (vitesse terminale) na lâ so ni tï na sese?
20261122-physics-m3-2.thinking.0: Ngü ti nzapa so atï na ndö ti nuage so
20261122-physics-m3-2.thinking.1: Bibe ti ndara na gingo nda ti ye
20261122-physics-m3-2.s.s1.prompt: Ngü ti nzapa so atï na ndö ti nuage so ayeke na ndö ti akilomètre mîngi, ti nyen ni la vitesse ti ni akpa kâ pëpe na ayeke ngbâ na mbeni vitesse so ayeke ngbâ (vitesse terminale) na lâ so ni tï na sese?
20261122-physics-m3-2.s.s1.explain: Tongana vitesse ti tï akpa, résistance ti air so ayeke na ndö akpa ngâ, na a ngbâ ngbâ na gravité so ayeke na yâ. Force résultante ayeke zéro, accélération a kpe, na ye ni atï na vitesse terminale so ayeke ngbâ.

20261122-physics-h1-1.material: [Mécanique avancée] A lance mbeni ye so masse ti ni ayeke 1 kg na horizontal na vitesse 20 m/s, na ndö ti mbeni falaise so ayeke 80 m. Distance horizontale wa ye so a sâra poro na lâ so ni asi na sese? (g = 10 m/s², a kpe résistance ti air)
20261122-physics-h1-1.thinking.1: Bibe ti ndara na gingo nda ti ye
20261122-physics-h1-1.s.s1.prompt: [Mécanique avancée] A lance mbeni ye so masse ti ni ayeke 1 kg na horizontal na vitesse 20 m/s, na ndö ti mbeni falaise so ayeke 80 m. Distance horizontale wa ye so a sâra poro na lâ so ni asi na sese? (g = 10 m/s², a kpe résistance ti air)
20261122-physics-h1-1.s.s1.explain: Temps ti chute vertical ayeke $80 = \frac{1}{2} \times 10 \times t^2 \implies t^2 = 16 \implies t = 4$ seconde. Ndali ti so mouvement horizontal ayeke uniforme, distance horizontale ayeke $x = v_x t = 20\text{ m/s} \times 4\text{ s} = 80\text{ m}$.
20261122-physics-h1-1.s.s1.hint.0: Kozo, mo bâ temps ti chute t: h = (1/2) g t² → 80 = (1/2) × 10 × t²
20261122-physics-h1-1.s.s1.hint.1: Sâra calcul ti distance horizontale x = v_x × t.

20261122-physics-h1-2.title: Ndali ti nyen ni la OLED (diode
20261122-physics-h1-2.topic: Ndali ti nyen ni la OLED (diode
20261122-physics-h1-2.goal: Sara kusala na a-ndia ti Ndali ti nyen ni la OLED (diode ti leke kpale ni.
20261122-physics-h1-2.material: Ndali ti nyen ni la OLED (diode électroluminescente organique) so a sâra ni na smartphone na télévision ti tongana ayeke kete na na contraste nzoni ahon LCD ti kozo?
20261122-physics-h1-2.thinking.0: Ndali ti nyen ni la OLED (diode
20261122-physics-h1-2.thinking.1: Bibe ti ndara na gingo nda ti ye
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.prompt: Ndali ti nyen ni la OLED (diode électroluminescente organique) so a sâra ni na smartphone na télévision ti tongana ayeke kete na na contraste nzoni ahon LCD ti kozo?
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.explain: Tongana courant atï, OLED a sâra ni na mince film ti semi-conducteur organique so asâra lumière tî-lo-même, ni la unité ti rétroéclairage so ayeke kota ayeke na ndö pëpe, na a kpe pixel ti fa noir parfait na ni awara contraste ti infini.
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.hint.0: LCD ayeke na rétroéclairage so asâra lumière na mbâgë.
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.hint.1: OLED so pixel oko-oko asâra lumière tî-lo-même (autoluminescent).
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.o.o0: Ndali ti so ala sâra ni na composant ti composé organique so asâra mbeni lumière tî-ala-même, na rétroéclairage ti mbeni pëpe
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.o.o1: Ndali ti so OLED ayeke mbeni liquide so asâra ni electricité pëpe
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.o.o2: Ndali ti so aleuse ti fluorescente so ayeke kete ayeke mîngi na yâ ti OLED
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.o.o3: Ndali ti so a sâra ni na fer na ndö ti verre
